title: Umsindo Owafinyelela Esihlalweni Sobukhosi
intro: Umuntu othwele kanzima wasondela esihlalweni sobulungiswa, izwi labo lithuthumela hhayi ngokwesaba kodwa ngethemba. Indaba yayingeyethu, kodwa isinqumo sayo sasizozwakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, siqede isiko elicindezelayo. Ubani lo mphefumulo osikhalazo sawo sasizwakala ngale kwezinkanyezi?
clues: Ngize ngenhliziyo enzima, ngifuna ubulungiswa endabeni eyayingibopha ulimi.
Isicelo sami sasingesona nje isithunywa; sakhuphukela ngale, kuLowo ozwa konke.
Amazwi akhulunywa ngami ayefana nezibopho zesikhathi esidlule sasendulo.
Ngaphikisana futhi ngacabanga, ngezinyembezi nangokucabanga okunengqondo, ngenxa yesithunzi sami.
Kwehla isambulo, sathulisa izindlela zakudala futhi savuma ubuhlungu bami.
Bangibiza ngokuthi ngingumuntu ophikisana nomyeni wami, futhi igama lami laqala ukufana nesahluko esangikhulula.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
